scope_basis: These generators read network-wide views, canonical party projections, or DAO ledgers without farm predicates. Their output must not be labeled as belonging to a selected farm.
policy: Network-only; farm-specific CLI requests fail before database access, direct generator calls reject location IDs, and automatic runs store the reports without a farm assignment.
focused_test_command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_report_generator_cli.py tests/test_dao_proposal_history.py tests/test_technology_roadmap.py tests/test_coordination_end_to_end.py tests/test_governance_integration.py -q
